added.note: The production website links this special teaser PV from Jump Channel. It is an announcement preview, not a complete episode or an international streaming announcement.

added.note: The official website links this first promotional video for Season 2. It belongs to the new season, rather than the first season or the separate television special.

added.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 — Official Production Announcement
added.note: The official site hosts this Season 2 production-announcement teaser. It is an earlier announcement video, not a new trailer for the October 2027 release-window announcement.

added.note: The production’s official Movie page links this trailer. The player shows the promotional video without assigning an unverified upload timestamp.

added.title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery — Official Main Trailer
added.note: Watch the main trailer linked on the official Part 1 movie page. This video promotes Awakening Mystery; it is not a trailer for the subsequently announced Part 2.

added.title: Black Clover Second Season — Official Trailer 3
added.note: Watch the third official trailer from Crunchyroll’s own channel. This promotional video is separate from the weekly episode and English-dub schedules.

added.title: Fool Night — Official Teaser 2
added.note: Netflix Anime’s second official teaser previews Fool Night. The teaser’s stated release date does not establish a universal local launch hour.

added.title: Firefly Wedding Live-Action Drama — Official Announcement PV
added.note: Fuji TV’s announcement PV concerns the live-action television adaptation. It is not the anime trailer and does not supply a full cast or episode schedule.

added.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint — Official Main PV
added.note: The anime’s official video page links this main PV from Showgate. It previews the series rather than changing the episode release schedule.

added.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 — Official Main PV
added.note: This is the official Season 2 main trailer linked by the production website. It is additional series context, not either of the creditless opening and ending videos discussed in this article.

added.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure — Official Character PV
added.note: Featured December release: this official character PV promotes The Apothecary Diaries movie. It is one title in this calendar, not a trailer for every December release.

added.title: Black Clover Second Season — Official Trailer 3
added.note: Featured fall series: this official Black Clover trailer provides context for the season’s returning anime. It is not a compilation of all news in this roundup.

added.title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 — Official Character Trailer
added.note: Featured January series: Netflix’s character trailer previews Sakamoto Days Season 2. Other anime in the table have separate trailers and distribution announcements.

added.title: Fool Night — Official Teaser 2
added.note: Featured November release: Netflix Anime’s second Fool Night teaser previews one of this guide’s streaming premieres. It is not a trailer for the full monthly lineup.

added.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 — Official Premiere-Date Teaser
added.note: Featured Netflix title: the Cyberpunk franchise’s official channel published this premiere-date teaser. It promotes Edgerunners 2 rather than every title in the October guide.

added.note: Featured fall return: Crunchyroll’s official Black Clover trailer previews one series tracked in this calendar. Other series and films retain their own dates, platforms and regional availability.
